## Objective
- Continue from the prior work and finish a complete, playable game, applying requested changes to the existing game without asking questions.

## Requirements
- Build request for “The Facility: Null,” a survival-horror game.
- User requested German/English localization, a polished title screen with creator credit, and multiplayer/co-op options; the original request also describes online matchmaking and bots.
- Save small JPEG screenshots for checks (viewport at most 1280px wide); read only the latest screenshot unless fine detail requires a full-size PNG.

## Decisions
- Prior assistant treated this as a self-contained, local-first browser game with Three.js, procedural environment/audio, localized menus, and offline co-op/bot lobby.
- It noted that worldwide matchmaking requires a hosted backend, so local lobby flows should not imply online connectivity.

## Work State
### Completed
- Existing implementation includes the Three.js first-person facility, gameplay progression, localization, menus, and lobby flows in `src/game.js`, `index.html`, and `style.css`.
- Earlier progression testing reportedly passed through the surface ending; missing favicon was fixed in `assets/favicon.svg` and linked in `index.html`.
- Earlier temporary debug APIs were removed; `node --check src/game.js` passed.
- Current workspace was clean at initial inspection (`git status` clean; HEAD `f66b92f`).

### Active
- Investigating a browser screenshot that unexpectedly shows only the title menu while `#pause-screen` and `#ending-screen` compute to `display:block`; their rects appear stacked below the viewport.
- Initial screenshot attempt timed out due to Playwright waiting for fonts; a CDP JPEG capture helper succeeded, and `/tmp/opencode/shots/menu.jpg` was read.
- Current investigation is examining CSS rule structure. Last diagnostic showed CSS rules nested under several `@1 [0]` entries, and `grep` found no useful selector matches.

### Blocked
- Root cause of the unexpected overlay/layout behavior is not yet identified.
- No new project files have been changed in this resumed session.

## Next Move
1. Inspect the CSSOM output and stylesheet source around the rules for `.game-ui`, `.pause-screen`, `.ending-screen`, and any media queries; determine why overlays render as block elements despite CSS declarations.
2. Reproduce relevant states in browser and verify menu, gameplay, pause, and ending screens with JPEG captures no wider than 1280px.
3. Fix any confirmed issue, run `node --check src/game.js` and gameplay/progression checks, then report assumptions and verification results.

- `index.html`: Game DOM structure, including menu, game UI, pause, and ending overlays.
- `src/game.js`: Game behavior, UI wiring, progression, and rendering.
- `style.css`: Main visual styling; current CSSOM/layout investigation is centered here.
- `assets/favicon.svg`: Favicon added during previous work.
- `/tmp/opencode/shotlib.mjs`: Temporary Playwright/CDP JPEG capture helper.

- Prior conversation is preserved in `.omgithub/conversation.json`; the original request and prior completion notes are in that history.
- Local HTTP server was started on port `3002`; captures were written under `/tmp/opencode/shots/`.
- Browser inspection reported `#game-ui` as `display:block`, `#pause-screen` and `#ending-screen` also as `display:block`, despite their expected hidden defaults; their bounding rectangles stack beyond the viewport.

messages.summary:
## Objective
- Finish the existing “The Facility: Null” game as a complete, playable survival-horror experience, continuing from the prior work.

## Requirements
- Include German and English localization, a polished title screen with creator credit, and multiplayer/co-op options.
- Original scope includes online matchmaking and bots; do not imply local-only modes are online-connected.
- For visual checks, save small JPEG screenshots at viewport widths no greater than 1280px; read only the latest screenshot unless fine detail requires a full-size PNG.
- Do not ask clarifying questions; make reasonable assumptions and briefly note them at completion.

## Decisions
- The game is implemented as a self-contained, local-first browser game with Three.js, procedural environment/audio, localized menus, and offline co-op/bot lobby flows.
- Worldwide matchmaking needs a hosted backend, so local lobby flows should not claim online connectivity.

## Work State
### Completed
- Existing game implementation includes the Three.js first-person facility, gameplay progression, localization, menus, and lobby flows in `src/game.js`, `index.html`, and `style.css`.
- Earlier progression testing reportedly passed through the surface ending.
- Added `assets/favicon.svg` and linked it in `index.html`.
- Earlier temporary debug APIs were removed; `node --check src/game.js` passed.
- Resumed workspace was clean at initial inspection (`git status` clean; HEAD `f66b92f`).

### Active
- Investigating why a browser screenshot shows only the title menu while `#pause-screen` and `#ending-screen` compute to `display:block` and have bounding rectangles stacked below the viewport.
- Initial Playwright screenshot attempt timed out waiting for fonts; CDP JPEG capture helper succeeded and `/tmp/opencode/shots/menu.jpg` was read.
- CSSOM diagnostics are in progress; rules appeared nested under several `@1 [0]` entries, and `grep` found no useful selector matches.

### Blocked
- Root cause of overlay visibility/layout behavior has not been identified.

## Next Move
1. Inspect `style.css` and CSSOM around `.game-ui`, `.pause-screen`, `.ending-screen`, and media queries to identify the layout issue.
2. Reproduce menu, gameplay, pause, and ending states in a browser; capture JPEGs no wider than 1280px.
3. Fix any confirmed issue, run `node --check src/game.js` and gameplay/progression checks, then report assumptions and verification results.

## Relevant Files
- `index.html`: Game DOM structure, including menu, game UI, pause, and ending overlays.
- `src/game.js`: Game behavior, UI wiring, progression, and rendering.
- `style.css`: Main visual styling and current CSSOM/layout investigation.
- `assets/favicon.svg`: Added favicon.
- `/tmp/opencode/shotlib.mjs`: Temporary Playwright/CDP JPEG capture helper.
- `/tmp/opencode/cssdump.txt`: Temporary CSSOM diagnostic output.

## Important Context
- Prior conversation is preserved in `.omgithub/conversation.json`; original request and prior completion notes are recorded there.
- Local HTTP server was started on port `3002`; captures were written under `/tmp/opencode/shots/`.

## Objective
- Finish the existing “The Facility: Null” game as a complete, playable survival-horror experience.

## Requirements
- Include German and English localization, a polished title screen with creator credit, and multiplayer/co-op options.
- Include online matchmaking and bots in the original scope; do not imply local-only modes are online-connected.
- Save visual-check screenshots as small JPEGs at viewport widths no greater than 1280px; read only the latest screenshot unless fine detail requires a full-size PNG.
- Do not ask clarifying questions; make reasonable assumptions and briefly note them at completion.

## Decisions
- The game is a self-contained, local-first browser game with Three.js, procedural environment/audio, localized menus, and offline co-op/bot lobby flows.
- Worldwide matchmaking requires a hosted backend, so local lobby flows should not claim online connectivity.

## Work State
### Completed
- Existing implementation includes the Three.js first-person facility, gameplay progression, localization, menus, and lobby flows in `src/game.js`, `index.html`, and `style.css`.
- Earlier progression testing reportedly passed through the surface ending.
- Added `assets/favicon.svg` and linked it in `index.html`.
- Earlier temporary debug APIs were removed; `node --check src/game.js` passed.

- Finish “The Facility: Null” as a complete, playable survival-horror experience, including investigation and repair of the overlay visibility/layout issue.

## Requirements
- Include German and English localization, a polished title screen with creator credit, and multiplayer/co-op options.

- Save visual-check screenshots as small JPEGs at viewport widths no greater than 1280px; read only the latest screenshot unless fine detail requires a full-size PNG.

## Decisions
- The game is a self-contained, local-first browser game with Three.js, procedural environment/audio, localized menus, and offline co-op/bot lobby flows.
- Worldwide matchmaking requires a hosted backend, so local lobby flows should not claim online connectivity.

## Work State

- Existing implementation includes the Three.js first-person facility, gameplay progression, localization, menus, and lobby flows in `src/game.js`, `index.html`, and `style.css`.

- `node --check src/game.js` passed.

### Active
- Investigate why pause and ending overlays appear below the viewport despite computing to `display:block`; inspect DOM/CSS and reproduce states in-browser.
- Verify recent uncommitted changes and capture current menu/gameplay/pause/ending screenshots.

### Blocked
- Root cause of overlay visibility/layout behavior remains unidentified.

## Next Move
1. Inspect `style.css` and overlay DOM/layout for `.pause-screen`, `.ending-screen`, and related parent elements; reproduce the reported off-viewport rectangles.
2. Test menu, gameplay, pause, and ending states in-browser; save JPEG screenshots at widths no greater than 1280px.
3. Fix any confirmed issue, run `node --check src/game.js` and gameplay/progression checks, then report assumptions and verification results.

## Relevant Files
- `index.html`: Game DOM structure, including menu, game UI, pause, and ending overlays.

## Objective
- Finish “The Facility: Null” as a complete, playable survival-horror experience and investigate the reported pause/ending overlay layout issue.

## Requirements
- Include German and English localization, a polished title screen with creator credit, and multiplayer/co-op options.
- Include online matchmaking and bots in the original scope; do not imply local-only modes are online-connected.
- Save visual-check screenshots as small JPEGs at viewport widths no greater than 1280px; read only the latest screenshot unless fine detail requires a full-size PNG.
- Do not ask clarifying questions; make reasonable assumptions and briefly note them at completion.

## Decisions
- The game is a self-contained, local-first browser game with Three.js, procedural environment/audio, localized menus, and offline co-op/bot lobby flows.
- Worldwide matchmaking requires a hosted backend; local lobby flows should not claim online connectivity.
- The pause and ending overlay layout issue was not reproduced at 1280×720; no layout fix was indicated by the browser geometry checks.

## Work State
### Completed
- Existing implementation includes the Three.js first-person facility, progression, localized menus, and lobby flows in `src/game.js`, `index.html`, and `style.css`.
- Browser checks verified German and English menu, pause, and ending text; local room joining is labeled as a local co-op link.
- Progression checks passed through keycards, generator restoration, elevator call, and defense setup; ending and loss states were also exercised.
- Pause and ending overlays occupy the viewport when shown; JPEG screenshots exist for menu, pause, ending, and gameplay states.

### Active
- Recent edits in `src/game.js` add German intro text and German field-journal/cassette subtitles; run syntax and browser checks to verify them.
- Review the existing uncommitted changes and determine whether any remaining confirmed defects need fixing.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Run `node --check src/game.js` and `/tmp/opencode/localizationcheck.mjs`; correct any localization or runtime regressions.
2. Review the latest relevant JPEG screenshots and capture any missing visual states at widths no greater than 1280px.
3. Re-run the applicable gameplay and overlay checks, then report results and assumptions.

## Relevant Files
- `/tmp/opencode/localizationcheck.mjs`: Newly created browser check for German/English intro and story subtitles; not yet run.
- `/tmp/opencode/overlaycheck.mjs`: Playwright overlay geometry and screenshot check.
- `/tmp/opencode/pt2.mjs`: Gameplay progression check through elevator defense setup.
- `/tmp/opencode/pt4.mjs`: Credits, local join, ending, and loss-state checks.

- `/tmp/opencode/pt6.mjs`: English/German menu, gameplay, pause, and ending checks.
- `/tmp/opencode/pt7.mjs`: Detonation/ending check.
- `/tmp/opencode/shotlib.mjs`: Browser setup and JPEG capture helpers.
- `/tmp/opencode/shots/overlay-menu.jpg`: Overlay-check menu screenshot.
- `/tmp/opencode/shots/overlay-pause.jpg`: Overlay-check pause screenshot.
- `/tmp/opencode/shots/overlay-ending.jpg`: Overlay-check ending screenshot.

## Important Context
- `index.html`, `src/game.js`, and `style.css` have uncommitted changes; the latest edits are in `src/game.js`.
- Port `3002` serves the project; initial Playwright navigations timed out, but subsequent reruns succeeded.
- `node --check src/game.js` and `git diff --check` passed before the latest localization edits.
- One `pt4.mjs` loss-state check left `mode: 'playing'` after its short wait; separate `pt5.mjs` confirmed the loss transitions to `mode: 'ending'`.

- Complete “The Facility: Null” as a playable survival-horror experience and verify pause/ending overlay layout.
- Review uncommitted changes and verify German/English intro and story-subtitle localization.

## Requirements
- Include German and English localization, a polished title screen with creator credit, and multiplayer/co-op options.
- Include online matchmaking and bots in the original scope; do not imply local-only modes are online-connected.
- Save visual-check screenshots as small JPEGs at viewport widths no greater than 1280px; read only the latest screenshot unless fine detail requires a full-size PNG.
- Do not ask clarifying questions; make reasonable assumptions and briefly note them at completion.

## Decisions
- The game is a self-contained, local-first browser game with Three.js, procedural environment/audio, localized menus, and offline co-op/bot lobby flows.
- Worldwide matchmaking requires a hosted backend; local lobby flows should not claim online connectivity.
- Pause and ending overlays filled the viewport at 1280×720; no layout fix was indicated by geometry checks.

## Work State
### Completed
- Existing implementation includes the Three.js first-person facility, progression, localized menus, and lobby flows in `src/game.js`, `index.html`, and `style.css`.
- Browser checks verified German and English menu, gameplay, pause, and ending text; local room joining is labeled as a local co-op link.
- Progression checks passed through keycards, generator restoration, elevator call, and defense setup; ending and loss states were exercised.
- Pause and ending overlays were checked at 1280×720; JPEG screenshots exist for menu, pause, ending, gameplay, and other states.
- Latest localization check passed for German and English intro, journal subtitle, and cassette subtitles via `node /tmp/opencode/localizationcheck.mjs`.
- `node --check src/game.js` and `git diff --check` passed.

### Active
- Review the current uncommitted changes and resolve any confirmed localization or runtime regressions.
- Review the latest relevant JPEG screenshots and capture any missing visual states at widths no greater than 1280px.
- Re-run applicable gameplay and overlay checks before reporting results.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Inspect the remaining `git diff` and confirm the localization edits are consistent with surrounding code.
2. Review the latest relevant screenshots; capture any missing states at widths no greater than 1280px.
3. Re-run applicable gameplay and overlay checks, then report results and assumptions.

## Relevant Files
- `/tmp/opencode/localizationcheck.mjs`: Playwright check for German/English intro and story subtitles; now passes.
- `/tmp/opencode/overlaycheck.mjs`: Overlay geometry and screenshot check.
- `/tmp/opencode/pt2.mjs`: Gameplay progression check through elevator defense setup.
- `/tmp/opencode/pt4.mjs`: Credits, local join, ending, and loss-state checks.
- `/tmp/opencode/pt5.mjs`: Solo and downed-player/loss checks.
- `/tmp/opencode/pt6.mjs`: English/German menu, gameplay, pause, and ending checks.
- `/tmp/opencode/pt7.mjs`: Detonation/ending check.
- `/tmp/opencode/shotlib.mjs`: Browser setup and JPEG capture helpers.
- `/tmp/opencode/shots/overlay-menu.jpg`: Overlay-check menu screenshot.
- `/tmp/opencode/shots/overlay-pause.jpg`: Overlay-check pause screenshot.
- `/tmp/opencode/shots/overlay-ending.jpg`: Overlay-check ending screenshot.
- `src/game.js`: Game logic, localization, and latest intro/story translation edits.
- `index.html`: Game screens and UI markup.
- `style.css`: Game presentation and overlay layout.

## Important Context
- `index.html`, `src/game.js`, and `style.css` have uncommitted changes; latest status showed 84 insertions and 42 deletions across them.
- Localization check initially failed because `__f.beginIntro` was unavailable; changing it to click `[data-action="intro"]` resolved the test, and it then passed for both languages.
- Earlier browser runs occasionally timed out, but successful reruns passed the relevant checks.

import { createRequire } from 'node:module'
import { join } from 'node:path'
import { readFileSync, writeFileSync } from 'node:fs'
const runtime = join(process.env.HOME, '.local/share/omgithub-playwright')
const require = createRequire(join(runtime, 'package.json'))
const { chromium } = require('playwright')
const config = JSON.parse(readFileSync(join(runtime,'linux.json'),'utf8'))
process.env.DISPLAY = `:${readFileSync(join(runtime,'display'),'utf8').trim()}`
const browser = await chromium.launch({ ...config.browser.launchOptions })
const ctx = await browser.newContext({ viewport:{width:1280,height:720} })
const page = await ctx.newPage()
page.on('pageerror',e=>console.log('PAGEERROR',e.message))
await page.goto('http://localhost:3002/?playtest=1',{waitUntil:'load'})
await page.waitForTimeout(1200)
console.log('hook',await page.evaluate(()=>!!window.__f))
await page.click('[data-action="intro"]');await page.waitForTimeout(200);await page.click('#skip-intro');await page.waitForTimeout(700)
console.log('fps',await page.evaluate(()=>new Promise(res=>{let n=0;const t=performance.now();const tick=()=>{n++;if(performance.now()-t<2000)requestAnimationFrame(tick);else res(n/2)};requestAnimationFrame(tick)})))
console.log('state',await page.evaluate(()=>({mode:__f.game.mode,pos:__f.player.pos.toArray(),inter:__f.nearInteraction()?.label,keys:__f.game.keys})))
const session = await ctx.newCDPSession(page)
const shoot=async f=>{const {data}=await session.send('Page.captureScreenshot',{format:'jpeg',quality:82,fromSurface:true});writeFileSync(f,Buffer.from(data,'base64'))}
const teleport=async(x,z,yaw=0)=>{await page.evaluate(([x,z,yaw])=>{__f.player.pos.set(x,0,z);__f.player.yaw=yaw;},[x,z,yaw]);await page.waitForTimeout(350)}
const tapE=async()=>{await page.keyboard.press('KeyE');await page.waitForTimeout(350)}

await shoot('/tmp/opencode/shots/med.jpg')

await teleport(4,-41.2); await tapE(); console.log('lab key',await page.evaluate(()=>({keys:__f.game.keys,obj:document.querySelector('#objective-text').textContent,bat:__f.game.battery})))
await shoot('/tmp/opencode/shots/labroom.jpg')
await teleport(0,-49); await tapE(); console.log('lab door',await page.evaluate(()=>({phase:__f.game.phase,obj:document.querySelector('#objective-text').textContent})))
await teleport(-3,-54.3); await tapE(); console.log('reactor key',await page.evaluate(()=>({keys:__f.game.keys,obj:document.querySelector('#objective-text').textContent,bat:__f.game.battery})))
await shoot('/tmp/opencode/shots/reactor.jpg')
await teleport(4,-61.2); await tapE(); console.log('power',await page.evaluate(()=>({power:__f.game.power,obj:document.querySelector('#objective-text').textContent})))
await teleport(0,-70.2); await tapE(); console.log('lift door',await page.evaluate(()=>({phase:__f.game.phase,obj:document.querySelector('#objective-text').textContent,liftDoor:__f.game.doors.liftDoor.visible})))
await teleport(3.4,-81); await tapE(); console.log('call',await page.evaluate(()=>({called:__f.game.called,hold:__f.game.hold,obj:document.querySelector('#objective-text').textContent,monster:__f.getMonster().userData.active})))
await shoot('/tmp/opencode/shots/defense.jpg')
console.log('hud',await page.evaluate(()=>({down:document.querySelector('#down-overlay').className,fear:document.querySelector('#fear-vignette').style.opacity})))

## Objective
- Complete “The Facility: Null” as a playable survival-horror experience and verify pause/ending overlay layout.
- Review uncommitted changes and verify German/English intro and story-subtitle localization.

## Requirements
- Include German and English localization, a polished title screen with creator credit, and multiplayer/co-op options.
- Include online matchmaking and bots in the original scope; do not imply local-only modes are online-connected.
- Save visual-check screenshots as small JPEGs at viewport widths no greater than 1280px; read only the latest screenshot unless fine detail requires a full-size PNG.
- Do not ask clarifying questions; make reasonable assumptions and briefly note them at completion.

## Decisions
- The game is a self-contained, local-first browser game with Three.js, procedural environment/audio, localized menus, and offline co-op/bot lobby flows.
- Worldwide matchmaking requires a hosted backend; local lobby flows should not claim online connectivity.
- Pause and ending overlays filled the viewport at 1280×720; no layout fix was indicated by geometry checks.

## Work State
### Completed
- Existing implementation includes the Three.js first-person facility, progression, localized menus, and lobby flows in `src/game.js`, `index.html`, and `style.css`.
- Localization check passed for German and English intro, journal subtitle, and cassette subtitles via `node /tmp/opencode/localizationcheck.mjs`.
- `node --check src/game.js` and `git diff --check` passed.
- Prior browser checks verified menu, gameplay, pause, ending, progression, and loss states; overlay checks were performed at 1280×720.

### Active
- Review remaining uncommitted changes and resolve any confirmed localization or runtime regressions.
- Review latest relevant JPEG screenshots and capture any missing visual states at widths no greater than 1280px.
- Re-run gameplay and overlay checks.

### Blocked
- Recent Playwright checks (`pt2.mjs`, `pt4.mjs`, `pt5.mjs`, `pt7.mjs`, `overlaycheck.mjs`) could not navigate to `http://localhost:3002/?playtest=1`; `page.goto` timed out after 30000ms while waiting for `load`.

## Next Move
1. Inspect remaining diffs and confirm localization edits are consistent with surrounding code.
2. Start or restore the local test server, then rerun the gameplay and overlay checks.
3. Review latest relevant screenshots, capture missing states if needed, and report results and assumptions.

## Relevant Files
- `/tmp/opencode/localizationcheck.mjs`: German/English intro and subtitle verification.
- `/tmp/opencode/overlaycheck.mjs`: Overlay geometry and screenshot check.
- `/tmp/opencode/pt2.mjs`: Gameplay progression check through elevator defense setup.
- `/tmp/opencode/pt4.mjs`: Credits, local join, ending, and loss-state checks.
- `/tmp/opencode/pt5.mjs`: Solo and downed-player/loss checks.
- `/tmp/opencode/pt6.mjs`: English/German menu, gameplay, pause, and ending checks.
- `/tmp/opencode/pt7.mjs`: Detonation/ending check.
- `/tmp/opencode/shotlib.mjs`: Browser setup and JPEG capture helpers.
- `/tmp/opencode/shots/`: Existing screenshots, including `overlay-menu.jpg`, `overlay-pause.jpg`, and `overlay-ending.jpg`.
- `src/game.js`: Game logic, localization, and latest intro/story translation edits.
- `index.html`: Game screens and UI markup.
- `style.css`: Game presentation and overlay layout.

## Important Context
- `index.html`, `src/game.js`, and `style.css` remain uncommitted; latest status showed 84 insertions and 42 deletions.
- Localization initially failed because `__f.beginIntro` was unavailable; using `[data-action="intro"]` resolved the test, which passed for both languages.

## Objective
- Complete “The Facility: Null” as a playable survival-horror experience and review the uncommitted changes, including localization and overlay presentation.

## Requirements
- Include German and English localization, a polished title screen with creator credit, and multiplayer/co-op options.
- Preserve the original scope of online matchmaking and bots; do not imply local-only modes are online-connected.
- Save visual-check screenshots as small JPEGs at viewport widths no greater than 1280px; read only the latest screenshot unless fine detail requires a full-size PNG.
- Do not ask clarifying questions; make reasonable assumptions and briefly note them at completion.

## Decisions
- The game is a self-contained, local-first browser game with Three.js, procedural environment/audio, localized menus, and offline co-op/bot lobby flows.
- Worldwide matchmaking requires a hosted backend; local lobby flows should not claim online connectivity.
- Pause and ending overlays filled the viewport at 1280×720; geometry checks indicated no layout fix was needed.

## Work State
### Completed
- Existing implementation includes the Three.js first-person facility, progression, localized menus, and lobby flows in `src/game.js`, `index.html`, and `style.css`.
- German/English intro and story-subtitle localization passed via `node /tmp/opencode/localizationcheck.mjs`.
- `node --check src/game.js` and `git diff --check` passed.
- Prior browser checks verified menu, gameplay, pause, ending, progression, and loss states; overlay checks were performed at 1280×720.
- Reviewed the latest menu, pause, and ending JPEG screenshots; inspected current diffs in `index.html`, `style.css`, and `src/game.js`.

### Active
- Finish reviewing the remaining uncommitted changes and resolve any confirmed localization or runtime regressions.
- Restore/retry browser checks, then review or capture any missing visual states at widths no greater than 1280px.

### Blocked
- Recent Playwright checks timed out navigating to `http://localhost:3002/?playtest=1` while waiting for `load`, even though the server process was running and `curl` returned HTTP 200 for `/` and `/src/game.js`.

## Next Move
1. Inspect remaining diffs and confirm localization edits are consistent with surrounding code.
2. Diagnose the Playwright navigation timeout and rerun gameplay and overlay checks.
3. Review latest relevant screenshots, capture missing states if needed, and report results and assumptions.

## Relevant Files
- `/tmp/opencode/localizationcheck.mjs`: German/English intro and subtitle verification.
- `/tmp/opencode/overlaycheck.mjs`: Overlay geometry and screenshot check.
- `/tmp/opencode/pt2.mjs`: Gameplay progression check.
- `/tmp/opencode/pt4.mjs`: Credits, local join, ending, and loss-state checks.
- `/tmp/opencode/pt5.mjs`: Solo and downed-player/loss checks.

- `/tmp/opencode/pt7.mjs`: Detonation/ending check.
- `/tmp/opencode/shotlib.mjs`: Browser setup and JPEG capture helpers.
- `/tmp/opencode/shots/`: Visual-check screenshots, including `overlay-menu.jpg`, `overlay-pause.jpg`, and `overlay-ending.jpg`.

## Important Context
- `index.html`, `src/game.js`, and `style.css` remain uncommitted; latest status showed 84 insertions and 42 deletions.
- `PLAYTEST` in `src/game.js` changes renderer settings when the `playtest` query parameter is present.
- The latest `src/game.js` diff was truncated during review; remaining changes still need inspection.

## Objective
- Complete “The Facility: Null” as a playable survival-horror experience and review the uncommitted changes, including localization and overlay presentation.

## Requirements
- Include German and English localization, a polished title screen with creator credit, and multiplayer/co-op options.
- Preserve online matchmaking and bots in scope; do not imply local-only modes are online-connected.
- Keep visual-check screenshots as small JPEGs at widths no greater than 1280px; read only the latest screenshot unless fine detail requires a full-size PNG.
- Make reasonable assumptions without asking clarifying questions; briefly note them at completion.

## Decisions
- The game is a self-contained, local-first browser game with Three.js, procedural environment/audio, localized menus, and offline co-op/bot lobby flows.
- Worldwide matchmaking requires a hosted backend; local lobby flows should not claim online connectivity.
- Prior overlay geometry checks at 1280×720 indicated no layout fix was needed.

## Work State
### Completed
- Existing implementation includes the Three.js first-person facility, progression, localized menus, and lobby flows.
- German/English intro and story-subtitle localization checks passed.
- `node --check src/game.js` and `git diff --check` passed; server at `http://localhost:3002/` returned HTTP 200.
- Prior browser checks verified menu, gameplay, pause, ending, progression, and loss states; overlay checks were performed at 1280×720.
- Reviewed the latest menu, pause, and ending JPEG screenshots.
- Inspected diffs for `index.html`, `src/game.js`, and `style.css`; title screen includes creator/concept credit and audio toggle has `aria-pressed`.

### Active
- Finish reviewing the remaining uncommitted changes, especially localization consistency and runtime behavior.
- Diagnose Playwright navigation timeouts and retry gameplay and overlay checks.
- Review the latest relevant screenshots and capture any missing states at widths no greater than 1280px.

### Blocked
- Playwright navigation to `http://localhost:3002/?playtest=1` timed out waiting for `load` and `domcontentloaded`; a diagnostic run nevertheless observed `document.readyState === 'complete'` and `window.__f === true`.

## Next Move
1. Inspect remaining diffs, especially `src/game.js`, for localization consistency or regressions.
2. Diagnose the Playwright timeout and rerun gameplay and overlay checks.
3. Review the latest relevant screenshots, capture missing states if needed, then report results and assumptions.

## Relevant Files
- `/tmp/opencode/localizationcheck.mjs`: German/English intro and subtitle verification.
- `/tmp/opencode/overlaycheck.mjs`: Overlay geometry and screenshot check.
- `/tmp/opencode/pt2.mjs`: Gameplay progression check.
- `/tmp/opencode/pt4.mjs`: Credits, local join, ending, and loss-state checks.
- `/tmp/opencode/pt5.mjs`: Solo and downed-player/loss checks.
- `/tmp/opencode/pt6.mjs`: English/German menu, gameplay, pause, and ending checks.
- `/tmp/opencode/pt7.mjs`: Detonation/ending check.
- `/tmp/opencode/shotlib.mjs`: Browser setup and JPEG capture helpers.
- `/tmp/opencode/shots/`: Visual-check screenshots, including `overlay-menu.jpg`, `overlay-pause.jpg`, and `overlay-ending.jpg`.
- `index.html`: Menu markup and creator credit.
- `src/game.js`: Game logic, localization, and runtime changes.
- `style.css`: Overlay and presentation styles.

## Important Context
- `index.html`, `src/game.js`, and `style.css` remain uncommitted; latest status showed 84 insertions and 42 deletions.
- A diff adds `renderer.useLegacyLights=true` and defines `LIGHT_GAIN=5` in `src/game.js`; inspect their surrounding changes for intended effects.
- A local server was running on port `3002`; the diagnostic browser run displayed the localized German menu and creator credit despite the navigation timeout.

## Objective
- Complete “The Facility: Null” as a playable survival-horror experience and review the uncommitted changes, including localization and overlay presentation.

## Requirements
- Include German and English localization, a polished title screen with creator credit, and multiplayer/co-op options.
- Preserve online matchmaking and bots in scope; do not imply local-only modes are online-connected.
- Keep visual-check screenshots as small JPEGs at widths no greater than 1280px; read only the latest screenshot unless fine detail requires a full-size PNG.
- Make reasonable assumptions without asking clarifying questions; briefly note them at completion.

## Decisions
- The game is a self-contained, local-first browser game with Three.js, procedural environment/audio, localized menus, and offline co-op/bot lobby flows.
- Worldwide matchmaking requires a hosted backend; local lobby flows should not claim online connectivity.
- Prior overlay geometry checks at 1280×720 indicated no layout fix was needed.

## Work State
### Completed
- Existing implementation includes the Three.js first-person facility, progression, localized menus, and lobby flows.
- German/English intro and story-subtitle localization checks passed.
- `node --check src/game.js` and `git diff --check` passed; server at `http://localhost:3002/` returned HTTP 200.
- Browser checks verified menu, gameplay, pause, ending, progression, loss states, and English/German localization.
- Latest menu, pause, and ending JPEG screenshots were reviewed; overlay checks at 1280×720 found no layout issue.
- `node /tmp/opencode/pt6.mjs` passed: English and German menu, gameplay, pause, and ending text were checked.

### Active
- Finish reviewing remaining uncommitted changes, particularly localization consistency and runtime behavior.
- Diagnose Playwright navigation timeouts and retry any checks they prevented.

### Blocked
- Playwright navigation to `http://localhost:3002/?playtest=1` previously timed out waiting for `load` and `domcontentloaded`, despite diagnostics showing `document.readyState === 'complete'` and `window.__f === true`; a later `pt6.mjs` run succeeded using `waitUntil: 'load'`.

## Next Move
1. Inspect remaining diffs, especially `src/game.js`, for localization consistency or regressions.
2. Determine whether any needed gameplay checks remain after the successful `pt6.mjs` run; retry only those still missing.
3. Report findings, validation, uncommitted status, and reasonable assumptions.

## Relevant Files
- `/tmp/opencode/localizationcheck.mjs`: German/English intro and subtitle verification.
- `/tmp/opencode/overlaycheck.mjs`: Overlay geometry and screenshot check.
- `/tmp/opencode/pt2.mjs`: Gameplay progression check.
- `/tmp/opencode/pt4.mjs`: Credits, local join, ending, and loss-state checks.
- `/tmp/opencode/pt5.mjs`: Solo and downed-player/loss checks.
- `/tmp/opencode/pt6.mjs`: English/German menu, gameplay, pause, and ending checks.
- `/tmp/opencode/pt7.mjs`: Detonation/ending check.
- `/tmp/opencode/shotlib.mjs`: Browser setup and JPEG capture helpers.
- `/tmp/opencode/shots/`: Visual-check screenshots, including `overlay-menu.jpg`, `overlay-pause.jpg`, and `overlay-ending.jpg`.
- `index.html`: Menu markup and creator credit.
- `src/game.js`: Game logic, localization, and runtime changes.
- `style.css`: Overlay and presentation styles.

## Important Context
- `index.html`, `src/game.js`, and `style.css` remain uncommitted; latest status showed 84 insertions and 42 deletions.
- A diff adds `renderer.useLegacyLights=true` and `LIGHT_GAIN=5` in `src/game.js`; inspect their surrounding changes for intended effects.
- `src/game.js` also contains a `PLAYTEST` query flag that reduces pixel ratio and disables shadows/postprocessing for browser checks.
- Local server was running on port `3002`.

messages.summary:
## Objective
- Complete “The Facility: Null” as a playable survival-horror experience and review the uncommitted changes, especially localization, overlay presentation, and runtime behavior.

## Requirements
- Include German and English localization, a polished title screen with creator credit, and multiplayer/co-op options.
- Preserve online matchmaking and bots in scope; do not imply local-only modes are online-connected.
- Keep visual-check screenshots as small JPEGs at widths no greater than 1280px; read only the latest screenshot unless fine detail requires a full-size PNG.
- Make reasonable assumptions without asking clarifying questions; briefly note them at completion.

## Decisions
- The game is a self-contained, local-first browser game with Three.js, procedural environment/audio, localized menus, and offline co-op/bot lobby flows.
- Worldwide matchmaking requires a hosted backend; local lobby flows should not claim online connectivity.
- Prior overlay geometry checks at 1280×720 indicated no layout fix was needed.

## Work State
### Completed
- Existing implementation includes the Three.js first-person facility, progression, localized menus, and lobby flows.
- German and English intro/story-subtitle checks passed; `node /tmp/opencode/pt6.mjs` checked menu, gameplay, pause, and ending text in both languages.
- Browser checks verified gameplay progression, lobby flows, credits, ending/loss states, and overlays; latest menu, pause, and ending JPEGs were reviewed.
- `node --check src/game.js`, `git diff --check`, and HTTP check to `http://localhost:3002/` passed.

### Active
- Finish reviewing the uncommitted changes in `index.html`, `src/game.js`, and `style.css`.
- Run targeted runtime checks for newer changes, including flashlight/battery pickups, gate interactions, generator/detonation flow, solo downed state, and audio toggle.

### Blocked
- None. Earlier Playwright navigation timeouts were worked around; the later `pt6.mjs` check succeeded.

## Next Move
1. Continue reviewing the remaining diffs, watching for gameplay or localization regressions in recent interaction, timer, and audio changes.
2. Run focused browser checks for the newer behaviors and re-run syntax/diff checks.
3. Report findings, validation, assumptions, and the uncommitted status.

## Relevant Files
- `index.html`: Menu markup, creator credit, localized screens, and HUD.
- `src/game.js`: Game logic, localization, lighting, interactions, and runtime changes.
- `style.css`: Overlay and presentation styles.
- `/tmp/opencode/pt6.mjs`: English/German menu, gameplay, pause, and ending checks.
- `/tmp/opencode/pt2.mjs`: Gameplay progression check.
- `/tmp/opencode/pt4.mjs`: Credits, local join, ending, and loss-state checks.
- `/tmp/opencode/pt5.mjs`: Solo and downed-player/loss checks.
- `/tmp/opencode/pt7.mjs`: Detonation/ending check.
- `/tmp/opencode/shots/`: Visual-check screenshots, including menu, pause, and ending JPEGs.

## Important Context
- `index.html`, `src/game.js`, and `style.css` are modified and uncommitted; latest status showed 84 insertions and 42 deletions.
- `src/game.js` includes `renderer.useLegacyLights=true`, `LIGHT_GAIN=5`, and a `PLAYTEST` query flag that lowers pixel ratio and disables shadows/postprocessing for browser checks.
- Recent edits add battery pickups, altered flashlight behavior, gate-use tracking, generator-triggered detonation, downed-player bleedout/revive handling, and bilingual intro/story text; targeted validation of these newer behaviors remains pending.

messages.summary:
## Objective
- Complete “The Facility: Null” as a playable survival-horror experience and review the uncommitted changes, especially localization, overlay presentation, and runtime behavior.

## Requirements
- Include German and English localization, a polished title screen with creator credit, and multiplayer/co-op options.
- Preserve online matchmaking and bots in scope; do not imply local-only modes are online-connected.
- Keep visual-check screenshots as small JPEGs at widths no greater than 1280px; read only the latest screenshot unless fine detail requires a full-size PNG.
- Make reasonable assumptions without asking clarifying questions; briefly note them at completion.

## Decisions
- The game is a self-contained, local-first browser game with Three.js, procedural environment/audio, localized menus, and offline co-op/bot lobby flows.
- Worldwide matchmaking requires a hosted backend; local lobby flows should not claim online connectivity.
- Prior overlay geometry checks at 1280×720 indicated no layout fix was needed.

## Work State
### Completed
- Existing implementation includes the Three.js first-person facility, progression, localized menus, and lobby flows.
- German and English intro/story-subtitle checks passed; `node /tmp/opencode/pt6.mjs` checked menu, gameplay, pause, and ending text in both languages.
- Browser checks verified gameplay progression, lobby flows, credits, ending/loss states, and overlays; latest menu, pause, and ending JPEGs were reviewed.
- `node --check src/game.js`, `git diff --check`, and HTTP check to `http://localhost:3002/` passed.
- Reviewed portions of the `src/game.js` diff and located the relevant runtime/reset functions and menu markup.

### Active
- Finish reviewing the uncommitted changes in `index.html`, `src/game.js`, and `style.css`.
- Run targeted runtime checks for newer changes, including flashlight/battery pickups, gate interactions, generator/detonation flow, solo downed state, and audio toggle.

### Blocked
- None. Earlier Playwright navigation timeouts were worked around; the later `pt6.mjs` check succeeded.

## Next Move
1. Continue reviewing the remaining diffs, watching for gameplay or localization regressions in recent interaction, timer, and audio changes.
2. Run focused browser checks for the newer behaviors and re-run syntax/diff checks.
3. Report findings, validation, assumptions, and the uncommitted status.

## Relevant Files
- `index.html`: Menu markup, creator credit, localized screens, and HUD.
- `src/game.js`: Game logic, localization, lighting, interactions, and runtime changes.
- `style.css`: Overlay and presentation styles.
- `/tmp/opencode/pt6.mjs`: English/German menu, gameplay, pause, and ending checks.
- `/tmp/opencode/pt2.mjs`: Gameplay progression check.
- `/tmp/opencode/pt4.mjs`: Credits, local join, ending, and loss-state checks.
- `/tmp/opencode/pt5.mjs`: Solo and downed-player/loss checks.
- `/tmp/opencode/pt7.mjs`: Detonation/ending check.
- `/tmp/opencode/shots/`: Visual-check screenshots, including menu, pause, and ending JPEGs.

## Important Context
- `index.html`, `src/game.js`, and `style.css` are modified and uncommitted; latest status showed 84 insertions and 42 deletions.
- `src/game.js` includes `renderer.useLegacyLights=true`, `LIGHT_GAIN=5`, and a `PLAYTEST` query flag that lowers pixel ratio and disables shadows/postprocessing for browser checks.
- Recent edits add battery pickups, altered flashlight behavior, gate-use tracking, generator-triggered detonation, downed-player bleedout/revive handling, and bilingual intro/story text; targeted validation of these newer behaviors remains pending.

messages.summary:
## Objective
- Complete “The Facility: Null” as a playable survival-horror experience and review the uncommitted changes, especially localization, overlay presentation, and runtime behavior.

## Requirements
- Include German and English localization, a polished title screen with creator credit, and multiplayer/co-op options.
- Preserve online matchmaking and bots in scope; do not imply local-only modes are online-connected.
- Keep visual-check screenshots as small JPEGs at widths no greater than 1280px; read only the latest screenshot unless fine detail requires a full-size PNG.
- Make reasonable assumptions without asking clarifying questions; briefly note them at completion.

## Decisions
- The game is a self-contained, local-first browser game with Three.js, procedural environment/audio, localized menus, and offline co-op/bot lobby flows.
- Worldwide matchmaking requires a hosted backend; local lobby flows should not claim online connectivity.

messages.summary:
## Objective
- Complete “The Facility: Null” as a playable survival-horror experience and review the uncommitted changes, especially localization, overlay presentation, and runtime behavior.

## Requirements
- Include German and English localization, a polished title screen with creator credit, and multiplayer/co-op options.
- Preserve online matchmaking in scope without presenting offline/local flows as online-connected.
- Keep visual-check screenshots as small JPEGs at widths no greater than 1280px; read only the latest screenshot unless fine detail requires a full-size PNG.
- Make reasonable assumptions without asking clarifying questions; briefly note them at completion.

## Decisions
- The game is a self-contained, local-first browser game with Three.js, procedural environment/audio, localized menus, and offline co-op/bot lobby flows.
- Worldwide matchmaking requires a hosted backend; local lobby flows should not claim online connectivity.
- Prior overlay geometry checks at 1280×720 indicated no layout fix was needed.

## Work State
### Completed
- Existing implementation includes the Three.js first-person facility, progression, localized menus, and lobby flows.
- German and English intro/story-subtitle checks passed; `node /tmp/opencode/pt6.mjs` checked menu, gameplay, pause, and ending text in both languages.
- Browser checks verified gameplay progression, lobby flows, credits, ending/loss states, and overlays; latest menu, pause, and ending JPEGs were reviewed.
- `node --check src/game.js`, `git diff --check`, and HTTP check to `http://localhost:3002/` passed.

### Active
- Review remaining uncommitted changes in `index.html`, `src/game.js`, and `style.css`, especially newer interaction, timer, and audio changes.
- Run focused browser checks for flashlight/battery pickups, gate interactions, generator/detonation flow, solo downed state, and audio toggle.
- Re-run syntax and diff checks after targeted validation.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Continue reviewing the remaining diffs, watching for gameplay or localization regressions.
2. Run focused browser checks for the newer behaviors and re-run syntax/diff checks.
3. Report findings, validation, assumptions, and the uncommitted status.

## Relevant Files
- `index.html`: Menu markup, creator credit, localized screens, and HUD.
- `src/game.js`: Game logic, localization, lighting, interactions, and runtime changes.
- `style.css`: Overlay and presentation styles.
- `/tmp/opencode/pt6.mjs`: English/German menu, gameplay, pause, and ending checks.
- `/tmp/opencode/pt2.mjs`: Gameplay progression check.
- `/tmp/opencode/pt4.mjs`: Credits, local join, ending, and loss-state checks.
- `/tmp/opencode/pt5.mjs`: Solo and downed-player/loss checks.
- `/tmp/opencode/pt7.mjs`: Detonation/ending check.
- `/tmp/opencode/shots/`: Visual-check screenshots, including menu, pause, and ending JPEGs.

## Important Context
- `index.html`, `src/game.js`, and `style.css` are modified and uncommitted; latest status showed 84 insertions and 42 deletions.
- `src/game.js` includes `renderer.useLegacyLights=true`, `LIGHT_GAIN=5`, and a `PLAYTEST` query flag that lowers pixel ratio and disables shadows/postprocessing for browser checks.
- Recent edits add battery pickups, altered flashlight behavior, gate-use tracking, generator-triggered detonation, downed-player bleedout/revive handling, and bilingual intro/story text; focused validation remains pending.
- The latest partial diff review covered `addKeycard(...)`, battery pickups, gate access, generator detonation, solo bleedout, and sound-toggle behavior; no focused test results for these newer changes have been recorded.

## Objective
- Complete “The Facility: Null” as a playable survival-horror experience and review the uncommitted changes, especially localization, overlay presentation, and runtime behavior.

## Requirements
- Include German and English localization, a polished title screen with creator credit, and multiplayer/co-op options.
- Preserve online matchmaking in scope without presenting offline/local flows as online-connected.
- Keep visual-check screenshots as small JPEGs at widths no greater than 1280px; read only the latest screenshot unless fine detail requires a full-size PNG.
- Make reasonable assumptions without asking clarifying questions; briefly note them at completion.

## Decisions
- The game is a self-contained, local-first browser game with Three.js, procedural environment/audio, localized menus, and offline co-op/bot lobby flows.
- Worldwide matchmaking requires a hosted backend; local lobby flows should not claim online connectivity.
- Prior overlay geometry checks at 1280×720 indicated no layout fix was needed.

## Work State
### Completed
- Existing implementation includes the Three.js first-person facility, progression, localized menus, and lobby flows.
- German and English intro/story-subtitle checks passed; `node /tmp/opencode/pt6.mjs` checked menu, gameplay, pause, and ending text in both languages.
- Browser checks verified gameplay progression, lobby flows, credits, ending/loss states, and overlays; latest menu, pause, and ending JPEGs were reviewed.
- `node --check src/game.js`, `git diff --check`, and HTTP check to `http://localhost:3002/` passed.
- Reviewed recent battery pickup, gate access, generator detonation, solo bleedout, and sound-toggle code paths.

### Active
- Finish focused browser verification of battery pickup, gate access, generator gating/activation, and solo downed recovery; the latest test script exercised these paths but failed before printing its collected results.
- Test sound toggle from the menu; the attempted in-game click timed out because the canvas intercepted pointer events while the header is hidden in-game.
- Re-run syntax and diff checks after any targeted fixes.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Adjust `/tmp/opencode/focused.mjs` to print interaction results before the sound-toggle step; rerun and inspect errors.
2. Verify audio toggle from the menu, then decide whether any actual behavior needs correction.
3. Re-run `node --check src/game.js` and `git diff --check`; report findings and uncommitted status.

## Relevant Files
- `index.html`: Menu markup, creator credit, localized screens, and HUD.
- `src/game.js`: Game logic, localization, lighting, interactions, and runtime changes.
- `style.css`: Overlay and presentation styles.
- `/tmp/opencode/pt6.mjs`: English/German menu, gameplay, pause, and ending checks.
- `/tmp/opencode/pt2.mjs`: Gameplay progression check.
- `/tmp/opencode/pt4.mjs`: Credits, local join, ending, and loss-state checks.
- `/tmp/opencode/pt5.mjs`: Solo and downed-player/loss checks.
- `/tmp/opencode/pt7.mjs`: Detonation/ending check.
- `/tmp/opencode/focused.mjs`: New focused interaction test; currently fails at the in-game sound-toggle click before printing results.
- `/tmp/opencode/shots/`: Visual-check screenshots, including menu, pause, and ending JPEGs.

## Important Context
- `index.html`, `src/game.js`, and `style.css` remain modified and uncommitted; latest status showed 84 insertions and 42 deletions.
- `src/game.js` includes `renderer.useLegacyLights=true`, `LIGHT_GAIN=5`, and a `PLAYTEST` query flag that lowers pixel ratio and disables shadows/postprocessing for browser checks.
- Current code adds battery pickups, altered flashlight behavior, gate-use tracking, generator-triggered detonation, downed-player bleedout/revive handling, and bilingual intro/story text; focused test results remain unconfirmed.
- The focused browser run reached the final sound test without throwing earlier, but its results were not logged; the sound-toggle click timed out with `#game` canvas intercepting pointer events.
